option_relations.rationale: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in adults (MIS-A) is a distinct post-infectious inflammatory condition, while myocarditis is inflammation of the heart muscle. They are not directly equivalent or in a clear subtype/supertype relationship in this context.
COVID-19-related cardiac injury with diffuse myocardial necrosis can be a complication or a severe manifestation of myocarditis, especially in the context of viral infections.
Fulminant COVID-19 myocarditis is a specific and severe form of myocarditis, directly aligning with the leaf 'Myocarditis'.
Cytokine storm syndrome is a systemic inflammatory response that can be a mechanism leading to or exacerbating myocarditis, but it is not the diagnosis of myocarditis itself.
